'''Bhargebba Six''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Dying Breed" /> located in the [[Bhargebba system/Legends|Bhargebba system]], a part of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a part of the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region surrounded by the [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]] known as the [[Stygian Caldera]], and was connected via the [[Descri Wris]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Nfolgai system/Legends|Nfolgai]] and [[Svolten system/Legends|Svolten systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Dying Breed" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> all life forms on Bhargebba Six began rapidly [[Death/Legends|dying]] out. An individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] visited the celestial body in order to obtain final biological samples before their irreversible loss. After receiving generous approval from [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tibris]], the visitor obtained valuable samples from Bhargebba Six, and an extermination was subsequently carried out on the astronomical object.<ref name="Dying Breed" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bhargebba Six was introduced in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, the celestial body was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Dying Breed," which was originally exclusive to Sith Empire&ndash;faction players and stated that the "mad" [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Tibris had ordered the extermination of all life on Bhargebba Six but allowed [[Biologist/Legends|biologists]] to take samples before the act had been carried out. However, this information, as well as that on the mission's outcome, was eventually removed from the mission text.<ref name="Dying Breed" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bhargebba [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Bhargebba Six, in grid square R-4.<ref name="TEA" />
